title: Engineering Manager - UI Platform
description: P-1413 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The UI Platform team enables frontend developers across Databricks to build exceptional features efficiently. We support hundreds of developers working in the frontend every week, providing AI-powered tooling, streamlined deployment pipelines, and best-in-class monitoring and observability. Our team owns the complete developer lifecycle — from local development through production deployment — using industry-standard technologies including TypeScript, React, GraphQL, yarn, and Node. The Impact You Will Have Lead a talented engineering team focused on delivering an exceptional frontend developer experience across the organization. Build and execute processes that translate product vision into delivered outcomes aligned with organizational goals. Attract, hire, and develop top engineering talent, growing the team's capabilities and impact. Ensure the team delivers high-quality, operationally excellent software with strong reliability and performance. Drive technical strategy and manage technical debt, balancing long-term architectural decisions with product roadmap priorities. Partner cross-functionally with product management and engineering leadership to define team mission and priorities. What We Look For 8+ years of software engineering experience. 2+ years of engineering management experience. 5+ years of hands-on experience in web frontend development, with strong experience in React-based applications. Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop engineering talent at various levels. Track record of attracting, hiring, and retaining top engineering talent who meet high hiring standards. Experience driving technical initiatives that improve team efficiency, code quality, and developer productivity. Strong ability to set and achieve ambitious team goals aligned with company objectives. Experience managing distributed teams across multiple locations. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents.
